title: Isandro and the Tide
author: Marguerite Almeida
blurb: Wendell Vane, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
